title: A Detention for the Playlist
author: Rafael Iversen
blurb: Paloma Reyes, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
